A source-supported inference is not a verbatim author's position. Clinical guidelines do not pronounce moral doctrine.
English and French wording must independently preserve the same limited claim; live canonical ownership must remain unchanged.
Only after all eight stages have original-passage support, documented exact opponent attribution where relevant, and detailed French proof-reading may full certification be considered.
Any named theological certification requires an independent competent human theological editor; this file does not claim imprimatur.
A clinically confirmed emergency is a factual medical claim, not evidence that its original clinical author advocates any given moral conclusion.
